summary: Audit Log System Testing Complete - All features working correctly. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All UI tests passed. GET /api/audit-logs returns paginated logs with correct structure. Filters (action_type, entity_type, user_id, search, date_from, date_to) work correctly. Audit logs are immutable (no PUT/DELETE endpoints). Login, supplier creation, and item creation all create audit entries. Manager-only access enforced (403 for non-managers). UI shows log table with action icons, entity badges, user info, and expandable row details.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend audit_log() helper correctly stores to 'audit_logs' collection with all required fields
GET /api/audit-logs correctly returns paginated response with logs, total, page, page_size, total_pages, users
Filters work correctly: action_type, entity_type, user_id use exact match; search uses $regex on description; date_from/date_to use $gte/$lte
Manager-only access enforced via require_manager() - returns 403 for non-manager users
No PUT or DELETE endpoints exist for audit logs (immutable by design)
Login creates LOGIN audit entry with entity_type=User
Supplier creation creates CREATE audit entry with entity_type=Vendor
Item creation creates CREATE audit entry with entity_type=Item
Frontend AuditLogPage correctly displays all UI elements with proper data-testid attributes
Filter panel shows 5 controls: action, entity, user, from date, to date
Row expansion shows old_value → new_value diffs for UPDATE actions, new_value for CREATE actions
Audit Log nav item visible in sidebar with Shield icon
